projection: Use exact two-pass independent-bank waveform-block gradient. In the diagonal learning-rate metric, remove positive waveform directional derivative from the Adam displacement. Recompute derivative after domain clipping and use original hard ADC trials.
motivation: First paired pilot: B PSD error -9.85%, waveform error +2.48%, ADC-rail flags increased by2 in each independent endpoint bank.
recovery_cost_accounting: Separate repeat of original setup, normalization and fixed endpoint; zero new optimizer updates.
archive_failure_handling: Operational results and arrays remain in active compute storage for analysis; no NAS probe or repair.
diagnostic_scope: Reconstruct original first rejected direction2 from the saved accepted endpoint and Adam state. No training.
hypotheses: Original projection differentiates cross-bank waveform product while hard guard evaluates squared two-bank mean.
Hard ADC and argmax can disagree with the local STE directional derivative.
The fixed247-parameter representation has not been demonstrated incapable; one accepted update cannot establish that.
probe_scale: One full original Adam scale per tangent. Pure positive-wave descent has the same learning-rate-metric norm as the unprojected Adam displacement.
stop_rule: Exactly one reconstructed direction and three mechanistic trials. Restore saved weights. No sweep or automatic optimizer continuation.
success_criterion: Reproduce original hard rejection, compare actual guard directional derivatives and hard readouts, identify whether either aligned direction passes existing hard gates.
